synth.notes:
Player: arrows move 3; blocked by colour 2 or 15 cells in the next rect (frame) or leaving the portal bbox.
Kick: next rect overlaps a block -> player stays, block slides 3/step with a push-chain closure of bumped blocks.
Chain stops on colour 2, portal bbox, player overlap, or non-fitting socket interior (bbox inset 1); colour 15 is passable for blocks.
Click on a block: player takes its rect, block removed; tokens re-ranked token_i by (y,x). Stateless.
Unconfirmed: fitting socket entry (tag change), actions 5/7 (treated as no-ops).
